briefings.title: Secretary Bessent on CNBC’s Squawk Box

people.name: Scott Bessent
people.role: Secretary of the Treasury, U.S. Department of the Treasury

briefings.tldr: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent detailed ongoing US-China economic and AI diplomatic talks, outlined aggressive new sanction implementations against Iran, and discussed macroeconomic conditions including bond market stability and inflation management.

briefings.title: What Trump and Xi Didn't Settle in Beijing, With Nicholas Burns | The President’s Inbox
briefings.tldr: While the recent Trump-Xi summit in Beijing established a temporary, detente-like cooling of tensions and yielded modest agricultural and aviation deals, it highlighted deep strategic divides over Iran, technology competition, and a highly controversial potential shift in US Taiwan policy.

briefings.title: 🔴 DIRECTO VISIÓN GLOBAL | Trump abandona China sin grandes acuerdos y Warsh se estrena en la FED
briefings.tldr: Donald Trump’s historic visit to Beijing concluded with modest commercial gains (Boeing, Nvidia) and a fragile diplomatic truce, while Kevin Warsh succeeds Jerome Powell as Fed Chair amid stagflationary pressures and low consumer confidence.

briefings.title: Orville Schell: The View From the Front Row of the Trump-Xi Summit | The Foreign Affairs Interview
briefings.tldr: The Trump-Xi summit in Beijing prioritized personal rapport and "strongman" optics over substantive policy breakthroughs, signaling a potential shift toward transactional "strategic stability" while leaving core tensions—such as Taiwan and industrial policy—largely unresolved.

briefings.title: Trump Xi Summit LIVE: Why Is Team Trump Under Digital Lockdown During China Visit? | Vantage
briefings.tldr: President Trump and a delegation of top U.S. business leaders are under a strict "digital lockdown" during their visit to China, utilizing temporary "clean" devices and vetted software to mitigate the extreme risk of sophisticated state-sponsored cyber surveillance.

briefings.title: BREAKING: Trump addresses Xi's WARNING over Taiwan
briefings.tldr: President Trump’s Beijing summit focused on leveraging personal rapport with President Xi to secure massive trade deals while maintaining a "status quo" policy on Taiwan and prioritizing the total neutralization of Iran’s nuclear capabilities over short-term domestic economic pressures.

briefings.title: Extended Interview: Tom Llamas sits down with Secretary of State Marco Rubio
briefings.tldr: Secretary of State Marco Rubio, attending the Trump-Xi Summit in Beijing, emphasized a "strategic stability" approach to China that combines direct diplomatic engagement with a rigorous domestic policy of re-industrialization to reduce reliance on Chinese supply chains.

briefings.title: Special Report: Trump and Xi give closing comments during U.S.-China summit
briefings.tldr: President Trump and President Xi concluded a high-stakes summit in Beijing, signaling a shift toward diplomatic stability and "fantastic" trade prospects—including potential multi-billion dollar Boeing and energy deals—while navigating deep-seated tensions over Taiwan and Iran.

briefings.title: The $10 Billion Hunt for the Rocks That Power the World
briefings.tldr: China’s near-total monopoly on the rare earth supply chain (80-90%) has become a critical geopolitical "bazooka," forcing a $10 billion global scramble led by the U.S. and allies to secure independent mining, processing, and magnet manufacturing.

briefings.title: Trump-Xi Summit, Benioff: "Not My First SaaSpocalypse," OpenAI vs Apple, Multi-Sensory AI, El Niño
briefings.tldr: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff and the "Besties" analyze the Trump-Xi summit's focus on economic entanglement as a deterrent to war, while addressing the "SaaSpocalypse" market rerating and the shift toward multi-sensory, agentic AI models.

briefings.title: Trump's China Deals Are Just 'Performance,' Says Ex-US Trade Rep
briefings.tldr: Former USTR Katherine Tai characterizes recent US-China trade summits as "performance art" that prioritizes corporate symbolism over structural rebalancing.

briefings.title: Washington Today (5-15-26): Pres. Trump talks about Taiwan, Iran, trade on flight back from China
briefings.tldr: President Trump returned from a Beijing summit without making explicit commitments regarding Taiwan’s defense or Iran, while the U.S. House passed a $157 billion military spending bill after soundly rejecting a Republican effort to defund NATO infrastructure.

briefings.title: President Trump & Chinese President Xi Meeting
briefings.tldr: President Trump’s state visit to Beijing focused on recalibrating the U.S.-China trade relationship and securing a commitment from President Xi to increase pressure on North Korea's nuclear program.

briefings.title: Special Report: Trump and Xi begin historic U.S.-China summit
briefings.tldr: President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping have commenced a high-stakes summit in Beijing, utilizing intense pageantry and personal diplomacy to address critical tensions regarding trade, the war in Iran, and maritime security.

briefings.title: What to Expect from the Trump-Xi Summit: A Conversation with Susan Thornton
briefings.tldr: The upcoming May 2026 Trump-Xi summit in Beijing aims to stabilize bilateral relations amidst global volatility, though observers should expect symbolic de-escalation and leader-to-leader communication rather than a "grand bargain" or major substantive breakthroughs.

briefings.title: The delayed Trump-Xi summit, Iran, and the US-China relationship
briefings.tldr: The postponement of the Trump-Xi summit to May 14–15 due to the U.S.-Iran conflict provides Beijing with strategic "time" to build leverage, as Washington appears increasingly distracted and burdened by Middle East operations and upcoming midterm elections.

briefings.title: Trump, Xi to Meet in Beijing on May 14–15 | The China Show 3/26/2026
briefings.tldr: President Trump and Xi Jinping are scheduled to meet in Beijing on May 14–15, 2026, as the U.S. insists the Iran war is entering its final stages despite public rejection of peace terms by Tehran.
